references.disposition: The source quantifies over all such square-zero extensions, not only split or finite ones.

review_rationale: Read the unique-lift property for every square-zero ideal I of any R-algebra A, preserving both existence and uniqueness of a compatible lift S→A. Formally étale is stronger than only formally unramified, and this is not simply the finite-presentation étale condition.
